args.description: drills upward spinning fast with both daggers held out. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy black hair and violet eyes, a long black coat with a ragged violet lining worn open over a dark shirt, black trousers and black boots, holding two curved violet daggers, one in each hand
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding two curved violet daggers, one in each hand
